## Get involved


Concrete things you can do next.


[Get 80,000 Hours career advice](https://80000hours.org/speak-with-us/) See our thinking on how to use your career to work on this.


[Join our headhunting database](https://app.80000hours.org/headhunting-database) Let promising opportunities find you.


[Apply to Project Tailwind for funding](https://coefficientgiving.org/tailwind/) Apply to get funding to start a new AI safety organisation.


[Find a local community](https://aisafety.com/communities) Meetups, reading groups, and online communities worldwide. Not all vetted, but a good place to start.


## Learn more


The Hugging Face attack is part of a[much bigger problem](https://huggingface.wtf/) . Here’s why people are worried about AI, and how to get up to speed.


[Why worry about AI?](https://80000hours.org/problem-profiles/artificial-intelligence/) How AI could transform the world, why the risks could be catastrophic, and what we can do about them.


[BlueDot Impact](https://bluedot.org/) Sign up for a free online course on AI safety; we think these are the best around.


## Are you an AI lab employee?


Get independent support to understand your options for raising safety concerns.


[Read AIWI’s guide](https://aiwi.org/guide/know-your-rights-whistleblowing-in-ai/)


Never use work systems to research whistleblowing, contact lawyers, message colleagues on concerns, or store evidence.
